plugins.descriptionZh: 把 DSH 接入飞书：斜杠命令变成控制面板卡片按钮，卡内审批与提问、流式回复，扫码即可完成配置。
plugins.descriptionEn: Run DSH inside Feishu (Lark): every slash command becomes a control-panel card button, with in-card approvals and questions, streaming replies, and one-QR setup.

plugins.descriptionZh: DSH 可视化插件市场：逛一逛，点一下，装好——在应用里直接浏览、搜索社区插件并一键安装。
plugins.descriptionEn: A visual plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness: browse, search, and one-click install community plugins.

plugins.descriptionZh: 为工作区建立知识图谱式代码索引：按结构检索符号、代码片段与调用链，并给出架构概览，让智能体先读懂整个代码库再动手，提出更准确、更贴合现有实现的代码建议。
plugins.descriptionEn: Builds a knowledge-graph index of the workspace: symbol and snippet search, call-path tracing and an architecture overview, so the agent understands the whole codebase before it changes anything and suggests code that fits what is already there.

plugins.nameZh: C 语言 LSP 导航
plugins.descriptionZh: 接入 clangd 的 C/C++ 语言服务：跳转定义、查找引用、查找实现与悬停信息，让 C 代码的定位和重构建立在编译器级事实之上，而不是靠猜测。
plugins.descriptionEn: Wires clangd into the harness for C/C++: go-to-definition, find-references, implementations and hover, so locating and restructuring C code rests on compiler-grade facts instead of guesses.

plugins.descriptionZh: 社区用量最大的 dsh 记忆插件：把历次对话与结论沉淀为可检索的记忆与上下文，让智能体记得住项目背景与既有决策，不必每次从零开始。
plugins.descriptionEn: The most-used DSH memory plugin in the community: turns past conversations and decisions into retrievable memory and context, so the agent remembers the project's background and earlier calls instead of starting from zero.

plugins.descriptionZh: 以「行动前回忆、关键工作后沉淀」的方式管理经验：Obsidian 兼容的 Markdown 经验库，带冲突检测与可选人工确认的沉淀流程——经验人可读、可版本管理、离线可用。
plugins.descriptionEn: Manages experience the recall-before-act, capture-after-work way: an Obsidian-compatible Markdown vault with a capture flow that detects conflicts and can ask for human approval — readable, versionable and offline.
